title: React v2 AI Narrator Panel: Typing effect and real-time streaming presence
goal: Implement the 'AI Signal' panel in Mission Control to make the AI feel present and intelligent. (1) Stream AI observations and proposals using a character-by-character typing effect (12ms/char). (2) Implement the cycling 'Thinking...' indicator when waiting for LLM responses. (3) Ensure AI proposals include inline [Approve] / [Skip] buttons directly within the typed stream, preventing the user from needing to navigate away.
generation_reason: User specifically requested that the system should feel like it 'lives' and takes the user along, rather than just displaying static info.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Focus only on the UI presentation of the AI signal. Assume the backend provides the necessary data streams.

success_criteria: AI messages appear sequentially with a typing effect.
Proposals have inline action buttons that function.

acceptance_criteria: Typing effect is smooth and inline actions are accessible.
